texts: doha about hearing inner music on a mountain with no instrument, a cuckoo too
On the mountain's silent shoulder a cuckoo falls still, and a music with no player rises from within.
mountain, cuckoo, inner music
Write a doha about a seeker on a mountain who hears the cuckoo go quiet, and then hears a deeper music inside himself that no instrument is playing, a sound that arises from silence itself.
Up on a mountain retreat, after the cuckoo stopped calling at dusk, I heard something humming inside my own head that no one was making, and it felt holy.
A seed of silence split open in me, and out of it sang a music that no hand had played.
Please write a doha about a seed of stillness that grows in the heart until the seeker hears an inner music no hand is playing and no ear could hear outside, the sound that has no source.
seed, soundless sound
After weeks of meditating in silence I started hearing a faint, steady music inside, as though a seed had cracked open somewhere in me, and nobody else could hear it.
doha on the music you hear inside when you meditate, with a seed in it
churn doha about the inner music that plays by itself, no instrument
churn, unstruck music
Write a doha about a churn turning slowly in silence while the seeker hears, from deep within, a music that nothing is striking, a sound that rises out of stillness and fills him.
The churn turns round, the cream rises, and a music with no maker fills the quiet inside.
At dawn, as my mother churned butter, the whole room went silent and I heard a low hum from somewhere inside me that did not come from anything around me.
My blind grandfather sits beneath the leaf-heavy branches each evening, and he says he hears music that comes from nowhere, from inside him, and it makes his face glow.
Compose a doha about a blind man who cannot see the world but hears, deep within, a soundless music that no instrument creates, and a leaf falling beside him that he feels but never hears.
doha with a blind man and a leaf about the music you hear within, no instrument
blind man, leaf, inner music
The blind man hears a leaf fall in the silence, and beneath it a music no instrument makes.
A leaf drops in the quiet, and from the silence behind it rises the unstruck melody.
I was sitting in the garden when a leaf fell and suddenly every outside noise vanished, and I became aware of a faint tune inside me that had no origin.
leaf, silent music
I would like a doha about the moment when a leaf falls in complete stillness and the seeker hears behind the quiet an inner music with no player, a sound that is not struck by anything.
leaf doha about the soundless sound you hear in deep silence
peacock doha about hearing the unstruck music inside, no instrument
Compose a doha about a peacock that dances at the sound of thunder and a seeker who needs no thunder, for he hears an unstruck music inside, with no instrument and no player, rising from silence.
peacock, inner music
The peacock dances for the thunder; I dance to a music no thunder makes, deep inside.
While a peacock screamed in the evening, I closed my eyes and heard, under all that noise, a gentle ringing inside my own chest that nobody else was making.
When the furnace goes cold and the noise is gone, a music with no instrument begins within.
The blast of the furnace at our workshop dies down at night, and in that silence I have started to hear something inside me, a music that is not any instrument's.
doha with a furnace - the inner music you hear with no instrument
furnace, silent music
Write a doha about the roar of a furnace dying into silence, after which the seeker hears an unstruck music from within that no hammer, voice or instrument has made, the sound beyond all sounds.
The lamp burns hushed, the pot of water brims; and into that silence the unstruck melody pours.
At night I sit by an oil lamp with a pot of water beside me and listen to the stillness, until I notice a faint music inside me that nobody put there.
lamp, pot of water, music
Please write a doha about a lamp burning in a silent room beside a pot of water, where the seeker hears an inner music no instrument plays, the soundless sound that rises from the heart.
lamp and pot of water doha - the inner music with no instrument
Write a doha about gold and a needle, the richest and the smallest of things, and say that neither compares to the inner music a seeker hears when no instrument plays, the soundless sound within.
gold, needle, inner music
My grandmother pawned her gold for a sewing needle once, she joked, but she says no jewel compares with the quiet melody she hears in her own head when she sits in silence.
doha with gold and a needle about the inner music with no instrument
Gold glitters and the needle pierces, yet the sweetest music is the one that comes from no strings.
soundless sound within
There is a music with no player, a song with no singer, humming at the root of the heart.
I would like a doha about the mystic experience of hearing, in deep meditation, a sweet inner music that no instrument produces, a sound without striking, the soundless sound that arises from within.
doha about the inner music heard in meditation that no one is playing
Late at night when the whole city is quiet, I sit still and hear a delicate melody inside, not from any speaker, and it feels like the most beautiful thing I've ever experienced.
unstruck inner music
Without a hand to strike it, a note arises; without a throat to sing it, a song begins within.
doha about the mystical music in your head that no instrument plays
Compose a doha about the music that is heard when the mind goes still, a melody with no instrument and no musician, rising from the depths of one's being and filling the entire world with sweetness.
When I stopped thinking during a long silent retreat I became aware of a vast, soft music underneath everything, and nobody was playing it.
Please write a doha in which the cuckoo's song and the prick of a thorn both fall away, leaving only the inner music of the heart, an unstruck sound that no instrument makes and no ear hears.
The cuckoo stopped singing and a thorn bush scratched me as I sat still, and in that quiet I heard a delicate inner hum that seemed to come from the very centre of my chest.
The cuckoo sings, the thorn pricks, and then both fall silent, and the unstruck music begins.
cuckoo, thorn, unstruck music
cuckoo and thorn doha about the soundless sound you hear in the heart
Write a doha about a heavy stone and a mound of ash, the hard and the burnt, in the stillness of which the seeker hears an inner music that no instrument produces, a sound without a source.
stone, ash, soundless sound
stone and ash doha about the unstruck inner music
The stone is silent, the ash is silent, and in that double silence the unplayed music rises.
Sitting by the ash of last night's pyre, on a stone ledge, I felt such a deep stillness that I began to hear a delicate music in my own chest.
music without instrument
While walking alone on a snowy morning with no sound anywhere, I suddenly heard a soft ringing inside that seemed to come from the centre of me.
I want a doha about the sweet inner sound that the mystics speak of, the music that is never struck by any hand or instrument, but arises in the depths of silence and fills the seeker with bliss.
No hand has touched a string, no breath has stirred a reed, and yet the whole heart sings.
doha about the unstruck music inside that mystics describe
The fire in our hearth crackled down to nothing and the room fell quiet, then I became aware of a gentle, steady humming inside me that nobody else could hear.
fire, soundless music
fire doha about hearing the inner music with no instrument
When the fire sinks to embers and the world grows hushed, the unstruck melody awakens.
Write a doha about a fire that dies into quiet embers, after which the seeker hears an inner music that no instrument is playing, the unstruck sound that rises from stillness.
cloth sheet, well, inner music
doha with a cloth sheet and a well - hearing the inner music in silence
I sat wrapped in a cloth sheet beside the village well in the quiet of the night, and began to hear a soft melody within me that no one around was making.
Compose a doha about a seeker wrapped in a cloth sheet who sits at the rim of a deep well, listening, and hears rising from within, and not from the well, an unstruck music that no hand plays.
At the well's cool edge, in a cloth sheet of silence, the music with no instrument rises.
Write a doha about the cuckoo whose sweet song is only an echo of the unstruck inner music, and the bitter gourd that is soon forgotten when the seeker tastes the soundless sound within.
I used to think the cuckoo's song and the taste of a bitter gourd were the most vivid things in the world, until I heard a silent music inside me that outshone everything.
cuckoo and bitter gourd doha about the unstruck inner music
The cuckoo sings, the bitter gourd is bitter, and the inner music with no instrument sweetens all.
cuckoo, bitter gourd, inner music
Please write a doha about a pot of water and a bitter gourd, humble things made nothing by the inner music, the sound with no source and no instrument, that fills the seeker's heart in silence.
doha with a bitter gourd and a pot of water about the unstruck inner music
In my grandmother's kitchen, with a pot of water boiling and bitter gourd on the board, I went quiet and heard a gentle humming inside that was not coming from the stove.
bitter gourd, pot of water
A pot of water, a bitter gourd, a silence, and out of it the unstruck song of the heart.
temple, swan, inner music
temple and swan doha - the unstruck music inside, no instrument
The temple is hushed, the swan glides by, and a music that no one plays rises in the heart.
Visiting the empty temple at dawn, with a swan on the pond outside, I felt such stillness that I could hear a faint melody inside me, though no one at all was chanting.

Write a doha about a silent temple where even the swan on the pond has gone quiet, and about the seeker who hears within himself an unstruck music, a sound that no instrument and no voice can produce.
The rope hangs slack and silent, yet the heart hears a sweet music strung from no instrument.
rope doha about the soundless sound inside
rope, unstruck sound
Please write a doha about a loose rope hanging in the stillness and the seeker beside it who hears an unstruck music from within, a sound that is produced by no hand, string or instrument.
Sitting on the deck of a ship in the quiet harbour with coiled rope at my feet, I heard a distant humming inside that I could not trace to anything outside.

Write a doha about a seeker wrapped in a plain cloth sheet sitting in silence at night, who hears the inner music rising within him, an unstruck sound that no instrument plays and no outer ear can catch.
Wrapped in a cloth sheet of hush, the seeker hears the music of the unstruck.
cloth sheet, soundless sound
cloth sheet doha about the inner music you hear in meditation
Wrapped in a cloth sheet on a cold terrace at night, I stopped all thought and started to hear what seemed like a faint music at the centre of me.
The priest at our gathering made the loudest music with his chants, but the churn in my kitchen went quiet, and I heard the true music, inside me, that nobody makes.
Compose a doha about a priest chanting loudly and a churn turning in silence, while the seeker hears a far sweeter inner music that no instrument produces and no priest can chant.
priest and churn doha - the inner music is better than the chanting
priest, churn, inner music
The priest sings out and the churn turns round, but sweeter far is the music that no hand strikes.
doha about the sweet inner sound you hear when your mind goes quiet
I want a doha about the mystical sound heard in deep silence, a sweet unstruck music that arises on its own without any instrument, and fills the seeker with a joy that outer music can never give.
soundless sound, inner joy
After my morning meditation I sometimes hear a soft, steady hum that seems to come from my chest and not from the world, and it leaves me with a joy I cannot describe.
Hush, and you shall hear it: a song that has no singer, rising sweet from the silence in your heart.
A leaf falls on the silent earth, and beneath its fall the heart hears the music that no instrument knows.
leaf doha about the soundless sound in the stillness
leaf, unstruck music

Please write a doha about a leaf fluttering down in total stillness, and the seeker who hears in that silence an inner music, a sound that is not struck by any hand or breath, from the depths of his being.
I was meditating in the autumn garden when a leaf drifted down, and at that moment I became aware of a sweet, steady music inside that I had never noticed before.
There is a song beneath the silence, a rhythm no one beats, a note no one breathes.
unplayed melody, within
When the party noise faded and I stepped into the empty garden, I heard in the new quiet a delicate melody inside me which no one else was playing.
Compose a doha about the sweetness of the music that arises within when the mind is at rest, an unstruck melody that needs no musician, no instrument and no audience, and is the Lord's own voice.
doha about hearing a melody inside that no one is playing
Write a doha about a cloud that passes silently overhead and a spinning wheel humming below, while the seeker hears a deeper, unstruck music from within that no wheel or cloud has made.
The spinning wheel hums, the cloud drifts by, and under both the music of the unstruck sings.
Under a drifting cloud, while my grandmother's spinning wheel hummed in the courtyard, I stopped everything and noticed that a deeper music was playing inside me, with no source at all.
cloud and spinning wheel doha - the inner music with no instrument
cloud, spinning wheel, inner music
Beyond the noise of speech and song, a music without a maker rises and fills the heart.
doha about that inner music that no one plays but you can hear
On the quiet commute home, with the radio off for once, I became aware of a gentle, steady music from inside, and I realised it had probably always been there.
inner music, no instrument
I would like a doha about the music that lives beneath all noise, a soundless sound that the seeker hears only when he stops listening to the world, and which no instrument or voice can make.
Compose a doha about the inner music that the mystics hear in deep stillness, a sweet sound that is not struck by anything, without an instrument or a player, a melody of the soul itself.
After years of ordinary prayer I recently began hearing a faint music in meditation that has no source I can find, and it has made everything else seem noisy.
Not the voice, not the hand, not the breath: the music of the unstruck is the soul's own voice.
unstruck sound, inner music
doha about the soundless sound that mystics hear
Write a doha about a fly buzzing in a silent room and a seeker who hears beneath its buzz an inner music, an unstruck sound that rises without any instrument from the quiet of his heart.
fly, unstruck music
fly doha - the inner music that is there under every noise
A fly buzzes, then falls still, and under its silence the unstruck song continues.
A fly kept buzzing around me as I tried to meditate, but when it finally left, I noticed a delicate music inside me that had been there all along.
The bee hums among flowers, the swan glides across the lake, yet sweeter than both is the unstruck song.
I stood watching a bee at the flowers and a swan on the lake, and when everything went quiet inside me I heard a lovely music that had no instrument.
bee and swan doha about the music that plays inside with no instrument
Please write a doha about the humming of a bee and the silent glide of a swan, and about the inner music the seeker hears that is sweeter than both, a sound without a player or an instrument.
bee, swan, soundless music
My uncle, a retired musician, says the finest music he ever heard was not in any concert hall, but inside him on a silent night, with no instrument at all.
doha about the best music being the one that has no instrument
The finest music is the one no one plays; it rises in the silence of the heart.
I want a doha that says no musician can match the inner music that arises in a quiet heart, a sound with no strings, no breath and no hand, which is the Lord speaking in silence.
music without musician
ash doha about hearing the unstruck music in the deepest silence
When all is ash and silence, the music of the unstruck is still playing in the heart.
ash, soundless sound
After scattering my father's ash by the shore, I sat in a hush so deep that I began to hear a faint, tender music inside, one that no one around me was playing.
Write a doha about the stillness left after everything has turned to ash, and the inner music that the seeker hears in that silence, an unstruck melody that no instrument makes.
doha about the sweet music inside that comes from no instrument, I heard it last night
Last night the world fell still and a music rose that no one had struck; I wept and did not know why.

Please write a doha about the experience of hearing a sweet inner music in the deep stillness of the night, a sound that no instrument or person makes, and that fills the heart with an unspeakable peace.
midnight music, no instrument
Last night I couldn't sleep, and in the dark silence I started hearing a soft rhythmic music inside me that had no source, and I lay there smiling until morning.
At my uncle's workshop the furnace roared and cotton bales piled up, but at night in the stillness I heard in myself a music that neither of them could make.
The furnace roars, the cotton lies soft and silent, and in the heart an unstruck music plays on.
Compose a doha about a furnace that roars and a heap of cotton that muffles every sound, in whose silence the seeker hears an inner music, an unstruck melody that no hand or instrument produces.
furnace, cotton, soundless sound
furnace and cotton doha - the inner music with no instrument
Beyond the last echo of the last sound, a note begins that was never struck.
Standing on the empty beach after a thunderstorm, when even the echoes had stopped, I became aware of an ethereal tune within me that seemed to have no beginning.
note never struck
I want a doha about the music that begins when every outer sound has died away, an unstruck melody from the depths of the heart that no instrument can play and no ear can hear, only the soul.
doha about the music that starts when all other sounds stop
Please write a doha that describes the soundless sound the mystics hear within, the music that is not made by any instrument, and says the one who hears it forgets every other sound in the world.
short doha about the inner music mystics hear with no instrument
inner unstruck music
Hear it once, the sound that no one strikes, and every other sound will seem a stranger.
Ever since the day I first heard that inner hum during meditation, the loud music my friends love sounds hollow to me, and I cannot explain why.
The scales cannot weigh it, the words cannot say it: the music that no one plays inside.
scales, inner music
doha with scales - the unstruck inner music can't be weighed or described
I tried to measure my progress in meditation with a diary of hours, like weighing goods on scales, but the real thing was a quiet music inside that cannot be measured.
Write a doha about scales that cannot weigh the inner music, the soundless sound that arises in the heart without any instrument, which no balance can measure and no speech can describe.
mountain, unstruck music
mountain doha about the inner music heard in total silence
The mountain holds its silence like a bowl, and in that bowl the unstruck song is poured.
On a ridge of the mountain, where the wind died and nothing moved, I felt a delicate music arise in me that seemed to come from the centre of my being.
Compose a doha about a mountain so silent that the seeker standing on it hears an inner music with no instrument, no wind and no voice, a sound that comes from within and fills the whole sky.
Write a doha about a cleric telling beads of prayer and the unstruck music inside the seeker, which no beads or voice can produce, the sound beyond all sounds that is the Lord's own voice.
prayer beads and cleric doha - the true music is the one inside with no instrument
The cleric counts his prayer beads and raises his voice; sweeter is the music none has struck.
The cleric was loud with his prayer beads all through the evening, but when he stopped, I heard in the silence a faint melody inside me that no one was making.
prayer beads, cleric, unstruck music
shadow, sword, inner music
The sword is sheathed, the shadow still, and the unstruck music rises from the heart.
shadow and sword doha - the inner music you hear with no instrument
My grandfather, a retired soldier, says that after years of the clash of the sword, the finest sound is the inner music he hears in his own shadow of silence.
Please write a doha about a sword that rests in its sheath and a shadow that lies still, in whose silence the seeker hears a sweet inner music that no instrument or hand has made.
doha: I heard a music from inside that nobody was playing
During a long silent walk with my teacher, I heard a faint, haunting music inside me, and when I asked him he just smiled and said it was always there.
inner music, no player
Not made, not played, not heard by ears: the music inside is the soul's own hum.
I want a doha for those who think they need an instrument to hear divine music, saying that the sweetest melody arises within, unstruck, and is heard only when the heart goes quiet.
At the oil press the engine noise stopped for the funeral rites at the bier, and in that sudden silence I heard a sweet music rising from within me.
oil press, bier, soundless music
The oil press stills, the bier rests, and in the silence the unstruck song begins.
oil press and bier doha about the inner music heard in silence
Write a doha about an oil press that falls silent at the side of a bier, after which the mourner hears an unstruck music rising from within, a sound beyond all outer grief and noise.
doha about the music inside you that plays with no instrument, a mystic thing
Beneath the thinking mind, a melody; beneath the melody, silence; beneath the silence, the Lord.
unstruck inner melody
Compose a doha about how the sweetest of all music is the one that is never struck by any instrument, arising within the quiet heart of the seeker, and drawing him toward the Lord.
After my son's wedding, once everyone had gone, I sat alone in the quiet and was surprised by a sweet melody that seemed to play inside my own chest.
moneylender and spinning wheel doha - the inner music, no instrument, no profit
The moneylender who lives near the spinning wheel workshop never hears the hum of anything but coins, yet his old mother says she hears a music inside her that no money can buy.
The moneylender counts his coins, the spinning wheel hums; the sweetest music is the one inside.
Write a doha about a moneylender who hears only the clink of money and a spinning wheel that hums on, while the true seeker hears an inner music that nothing outside can make or buy.
moneylender, spinning wheel, music
market doha about the inner music you hear in the middle of the noise
Please write a doha about a loud market full of noise and a seeker who walks through it and hears underneath it all a calm inner music, an unstruck sound that nothing in the crowd has made.
market, soundless sound
In the market's din, beneath the haggling, the unstruck music hums on in the heart.
In the middle of the vegetable market on a Saturday, with everyone shouting, I suddenly had the odd sense of a quiet music inside me that drowned out all the noise.
music no ear hears
A song without a singer, a sound without a sound, the Lord's own voice within the heart.
doha about the soundless sound that mystics talk about, in simple words
My teacher once asked me to sit still and just listen, and after some weeks I started to notice a soft inner music that seemed not to come from anything.
Compose a doha about the soundless sound that the mystics speak of, a melody that arises without any instrument in the stillness of the heart, and which draws the soul toward the Lord like a call.
Some hear the beat, some hear the song; the lover hears the music that no one strikes.
unstruck music, lover
doha about the divine music lovers of God hear inside
I'd like a doha that says that those who love the Lord truly come to hear, in the quiet of their hearts, an unstruck music that is the Lord's own call, and nothing outside can compare to it.
My aunt, whose devotion is the deepest I know, once told me with a smile that she hears a faint music when she prays, but there are no instruments anywhere.

Please write a doha about a well in which the water sings no song, yet the seeker beside it hears from within himself the unstruck music, a sound with no instrument and no maker, sweeter than any water.
I stood beside the water well at the village, in total silence, and heard in myself a lovely music that sounded like nothing in the world outside.
The well is silent, the water is still, and the unstruck music rings in the heart.
well doha about the soundless inner music, no instrument
well, unstruck music
doha about the music you hear inside, as if from nowhere
music from nowhere
A music from nowhere, a song from no one, and the heart knows it as the voice of the Beloved.
I want a doha about the inner music that appears from nowhere and no one in the quiet of the heart, which the lover of God recognises as His voice calling, and which no instrument could ever make.
One evening in the middle of an ordinary chore I suddenly heard a sweet music that seemed to come from nowhere, and I stopped and just listened with my whole being.
At the furnace in my uncle's foundry the heat finally died down, and in the sudden quiet I could hear a gentle music inside me that I had never noticed over the roar.
furnace, soundless music
The furnace falls silent, and the unstruck melody that was always playing is at last heard.
furnace doha about the inner music you can only hear in silence
Compose a doha about a furnace whose roar covers every other sound, until it is quenched and the seeker hears beneath the silence an unstruck music that no instrument or hand has ever made.
